title: Results table
subject: Science
unit: Spring 2: Reactivity (9F); energy transfer by heating
source: Written for science/y9 lessons 28, 33 (Results table (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 28: Making gases and conservation of mass. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To see if mass is conserved when a gas is made
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Put a little vinegar in the bottle and bicarbonate in the balloon
Weigh the bottle with the balloon beside it
Fit the balloon and tip in the powder; never use a lid
Weigh again with the balloon on
Repeat with the bottle open (no balloon)

questions.q: Big question: has matter been destroyed in the open cup?
questions.a: No: carbon dioxide escaped into the air.
